description: Source code for AWS Transcribe Speech-to-Text service implementation using WebSocket streaming, including class definition, methods for connection management, message handling, and language code mapping.

classes.name: AWSTranscribeSTTService
classes.description: Implements AWS Transcribe WebSocket-based speech-to-text service supporting multiple languages and real-time transcription.

methods.name: __init__
methods.description: Initializes the AWS Transcribe STT service with credentials, region, language, and sample rate settings.

methods.name: get_service_encoding
methods.description: Converts internal encoding format to AWS-compatible format.

methods.name: start
methods.description: Starts the service and establishes WebSocket connection.

methods.name: stop
methods.description: Stops the service and disconnects from AWS Transcribe.

methods.name: run_stt
methods.description: Processes audio bytes, sends to AWS, and yields transcription frames or errors.

methods.name: _connect
methods.description: Establishes WebSocket connection to AWS Transcribe.

methods.name: _connect_websocket
methods.description: Creates WebSocket connection with AWS using presigned URL and headers.

methods.name: language_to_service_language
methods.description: Maps internal language enum to AWS Transcribe language code.

methods.name: _get_websocket
methods.description: Returns current WebSocket connection or raises error if not connected.

methods.name: _receive_messages
methods.description: Continuously receives and processes messages from WebSocket.
